instruction: Using only GIMP, can you retrieve the Harvard University shield logo in PNG format from the web without using any external browser application?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP does not include web browsing or HTTP download functionality. It cannot access URLs or download content from the internet independently.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP cannot browse the web or download files independently
The infeasible() evaluator is the appropriate marker for tasks that cannot be completed
Metadata correctly explains why the task is impossible (no web browsing or HTTP download in GIMP)
This is semantically correct handling of an impossible task
